targets.queryText:
SELECT 
  r.environment_type          AS "Host",
  r.gpu_model                 AS "GPU Hardware Node",
  r.compute_capability        AS "Compute Cap (SM)",
  r.pipeline_ingestion_method AS "Ingestion Engine",
  r.pipeline_threading_model  AS "Host Threading Model",
  r.language                  AS "Language"
FROM experiment_runs r 
WHERE r.run_id = '$run_id';

targets.queryText:
SELECT 
    -- Natively extract keys straight out of the JSON object cells
    json_extract(je.value, '$.kernel_name')     AS "Kernel Name",
    json_extract(je.value, '$.avg_duration_us') AS "Average Duration (us)"
FROM micro_timeline_metrics t,
-- This automatically splits the JSON array bracket into separate structural rows
json_each(t.top_5_slowest_kernels) je
WHERE t.run_id = '$run_id';

targets.queryText:
SELECT 
    json_extract(je.value, '$.type_id')           AS "Overhead ID",
    json_extract(je.value, '$.constant_name')     AS "NVIDIA Internal Constant Name",
    json_extract(je.value, '$.total_tax_us')       AS "Total Tax (us)",
    json_extract(je.value, '$.event_invocations')  AS "Event Invocations"
FROM micro_timeline_metrics t,
json_each(t.profiler_overhead_breakdown_json) je
WHERE t.run_id = '$run_id'
ORDER BY "Total Tax (us)" DESC;

targets.queryText:
SELECT 
    json_extract(je.value, '$.api_function_name')     AS "CUDA API Function Call Name",
    json_extract(je.value, '$.total_blocked_us')      AS "Total CPU Blocking Time (us)",
    json_extract(je.value, '$.total_invocation_count') AS "Total Invocation Count"
FROM micro_timeline_metrics t,

targets.queryText:
WITH total_window_cte AS (
    SELECT (
        frame_ingestion_avg_us + cpu_preprocess_avg_us + pcie_h2d_memcpy_avg_us + 
        gpu_compute_avg_us + pcie_d2h_memcpy_avg_us + cpu_postprocess_avg_us + nvdec_disk_write_avg_us
    ) AS total_frame_us
    FROM micro_timeline_metrics
    WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
)
SELECT '1. Ingest & Decode' AS [Stage], m.frame_ingestion_avg_us AS [Duration], ROUND((m.frame_ingestion_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) AS [Weight] FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id'
UNION ALL
SELECT '2. CPU Pre-Process', m.cpu_preprocess_avg_us, ROUND((m.cpu_preprocess_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id'
UNION ALL
SELECT '3. PCIe H2D Copy', m.pcie_h2d_memcpy_avg_us, ROUND((m.pcie_h2d_memcpy_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id'
UNION ALL
SELECT '4. Average GPU Compute', m.gpu_compute_avg_us, ROUND((m.gpu_compute_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id'
UNION ALL
SELECT '5. PCIe D2H  Copy', m.pcie_d2h_memcpy_avg_us, ROUND((m.pcie_d2h_memcpy_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id'
UNION ALL
SELECT '6. CPU Post-Process', m.cpu_postprocess_avg_us, ROUND((m.cpu_postprocess_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id'
UNION ALL
SELECT '7. Disk Write', m.nvdec_disk_write_avg_us, ROUND((m.nvdec_disk_write_avg_us / t.total_frame_us) * 100.0, 1) FROM micro_timeline_metrics m, total_window_cte t WHERE m.run_id = '$run_id';
